title: AI Stocks Are Picking Sides as Stablecoins Drive Wider Crypto Traction
author: Eastern-Apartment934
selftext: AI names are no longer getting a free pass across the board — the market’s now sorting which firms can turn hype into actual sustainable profits. Semis are split too, while inverse semiconductor ETFs popped even as leveraged bull plays softened. Stablecoins look like the real on-ramp for mainstream crypto adoption right now, way more practical than waiting on broad speculative bids. Anyone else noticing this sharp rotation away from broad AI indiscriminate buying?

comments.author: Kira1Cloud
comments.body: We're finally getting back to fundamentals. AI is still a huge theme, but not every company mentioning it deserves the same multiple.
